chapters.englishTitle: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 1
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 1
hadiths.translation: The report is not like witnessing

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 2
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 2
hadiths.translation: War is deception

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 3
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 3
hadiths.translation: A Muslim is a mirror of the Muslim

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 4
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 4
hadiths.translation: Someone whose advice is sought is in a position of trust

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 5
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 5
hadiths.translation: The person guiding (someone) to do a good deed, is like the one performing the good deed

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 6
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 6
hadiths.translation: Seek help for any needs discreetly

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 7
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 7
hadiths.translation: Protect yourself from the fire even with a part of a date

hadiths.arabic: الدُّنْیَا سِجْنُ الْمُؤمِنِ وَ جَنَّةُ الْکَافِرِ
hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 8
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 8
hadiths.translation: The world is the believer’s prison and the disbeliever’s paradise

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 9
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 9
hadiths.translation: Modesty is entirely good

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 10
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 10
hadiths.translation: The word of the believer is like seizing of the hand

hadiths.arabic: لَا یَحِلُّ لِمُؤمِنٍ اَنْ یَّجُهْرَ أخَاهُ فَوقَ ثَلَاثَةِ أیَّامٍ
hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 11
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 11
hadiths.translation: It is unlawful for a believer to sever relations with his brother for more than three days

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 12
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 12
hadiths.translation: He is not one of us who cheats us

hadiths.arabic: مَا قَلَّ وَكَفَى خَيْرٌ مِمَّا كَثُرَ وَأَلْهَى
hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 13
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 13
hadiths.translation: A little that suffices is better than an abundance that distracts

hadiths.arabic: الرَّاجِعُ فِيْ هِبَتِهِ کَالرَّاجِعِ فِيْ قَیْئِهِ
hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 14
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 14
hadiths.translation: Someone who takes back his gift is like someone who eats his vomit

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 15
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 15
hadiths.translation: Affliction comes from (loose) talk

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 16
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 16
hadiths.translation: People are like the teeth of a comb

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 17
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 17
hadiths.translation: Richness lies in the richness of the soul

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 18
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 18
hadiths.translation: The felicitous person takes lessons from (the actions of) others

hadiths.arabic: وَ إِنَّ مِنَ الشِّعْرِ لَحِکْمَةً وَاِنَّ مِنَ الْبَیَانِ لَسِحْرًا
hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 19
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 19
hadiths.translation: Indeed, in poetry there is wisdom and in eloquence there is magic

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 20
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 20
hadiths.translation: The king’s pardon preserves the kingdom

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 21
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 21
hadiths.translation: A man will be with whom he loves

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 22
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 22
hadiths.translation: A man who knows his worth will not be ruined

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 23
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 23
hadiths.translation: The child belongs to the bed and stoning is for the adulterer

hadiths.arabic: الْیَدُ الْعُلْیَا خَیْرٌ مِّنَ الْیَدِ السُّفْلَی
hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 24
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 24
hadiths.translation: The upper hand is superior to the lower hand

hadiths.arabic: لَا شَکَرَ اللهَ مَنْ لَّا یَشْکُرُ النَّاسَ
hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 25
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 25
hadiths.translation: He does not thank Allah who does not thank people

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 26
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 26
hadiths.translation: Your love of something can blind and deafen (you)

hadiths.arabic: جُبِلَتِ الْقُلُوبُ عَلی حُبَّ مَنْ اَحْسَنَ اِلَیْهَا وَ بُغْضِ مَنْ اَسَاءَ اِلَیْهَا
hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 27
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 27
hadiths.translation: Hearts are predisposed to love someone who does them good and detest someone who does them harm

hadiths.arabic: الْتَّائِبُ مِنَ الذَّنْبِ کَمَنْ لَا ذَنْبَ لَهُ
hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 28
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 28
hadiths.translation: One who repents from sin is like someone without sin

hadiths.arabic: الشَّاهِدُ یَرَی مَا لَا یَرَاهُ الْغَائِبُ
hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 29
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 29
hadiths.translation: The person who actually witnesses an (event) sees that which one who is absent does not

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 30
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 30
hadiths.translation: If the nobleman of a people comes to you, honour him

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 31
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 31
hadiths.translation: False oaths lay waste to home (lands)

hadiths.arabic: مَنْ قُتِلَ دُونَ مَالِهِ فَهُوَ شَهِیْدٌ
hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 32
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 32
hadiths.translation: Whoever is killed attempting to save his property is a martyr

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 33
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 33
hadiths.translation: Actions are through intentions

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 34
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 34
hadiths.translation: The leader of a people is their servant

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 35
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 35
hadiths.translation: The best of affairs is that which is balanced

hadiths.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ فِیْ أُمَّتِیْ فِی بُکُوْرِهَا یَوْمَ الْخَمِیْسِ
hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 36
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 36
hadiths.translation: O Allah, bless my nation in its early rising on Thursdays

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 37
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 37
hadiths.translation: Poverty can almost turn into disbelief

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 38
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 38
hadiths.translation: Travelling is a portion of punishment

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 39
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 39
hadiths.translation: The best of provision is God-Consciousness (taqwa)

hadiths.cleanReference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 40
hadiths.collectionName: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadiths.reference: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi 40
hadiths.translation: Meetings are under trust
